meta.title: Every price cell on a multi-line sheet is filled
gaps: Directly count the filled vendor bid-sheet price cells and assert that the count equals the three-row line-item count.
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`
can only test part of this — no step for: Directly count the filled vendor bid-sheet price cells and assert that the count equals the three-row line-item count.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Create an RFQ pricing stage rather than the default auction stage.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Create the three-line event required by the case.
Verify that exactly three line items are present.
Populate the required pricing-sheet fields for all three lines.
Commit a bidding schedule so the event can be published.
Invite the QA vendor that will submit the bid.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Verify that the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor session.
Open the event’s RFQ bid sheet in the supplier portal.
Enter a price in every price cell and submit the quote.
Verify that the vendor submission was accepted.
Return to the buyer’s event page.
Open the buyer comparison grid for the submitted bid.
Verify that the submitted vendor appears as a real vendor column.
Check every line item’s displayed rate and amount, plus the total, confirming the buyer comparison contains prices for all three lines.
